cards.title: 一笔成功的生意
cards.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create an original landscape 16:9 illustration for ONE of five matching comic-style onboarding cards for BakaFactory, an absurd cozy post-human factory game. Full-bleed artwork only, no multi-panel grid, no page layout, no title or story caption area.
Shared art direction: Japanese color manga / anime background art, expressive hand-inked contours, slightly imperfect pencil lines, gouache/watercolor shading, restrained screentone and paper grain. Vaporwave peach sunset, dusty lilac, deep indigo, neon cyan and hot-pink practical signs; whimsical used machinery and warm lived-in clutter. Soft approachable hand-drawn industrial world, not glossy hard-surface sci-fi, not photoreal, not 3D render. Funny deadpan corporate absurdity, mild melancholy and optimism, no horror, no war or weapons.
Character continuity whenever BAKA-01 appears: one short adult-coded service robot about 3 heads tall, rounded rectangular cream/off-white head, dark navy rectangular face display with two cyan expressive pixel eyes, tiny copper single antenna tipped with a pink bead on the head's left side, scuffed mustard-yellow compact torso, faded diagonal black/yellow safety stripe on one corner, teal fabric work scarf, simple articulated limbs, oversized rust-red work boots, metal pincer hands (not human hands), small cream chest identification plate 'BAKA-01'. Clearly a friendly capable industrial robot, no human face, no giant armor. Keep this exact design throughout.
Use limited small in-world lettering only when requested. Do not put dialogue bubbles, subtitles, watermarks, large explanatory text, or story paragraphs in the artwork. Main story text will be separately laid out below the image in the game.
CARD 1 / A successful business deal. A cinematic wide view from low Earth orbit: the curved Earth below has violet oceans, enormous comically colorful continents of electronic waste and a hazy peach atmosphere. Two unmistakably different traffic flows cross the scene: graceful white human emigration ships with warm golden cabin windows recede upward toward the distant stars, while a queue of squat absurdly overstuffed garbage freighters shaped like municipal trash trucks descends toward Earth, carrying strapped-together refrigerators, CRT monitors and scrap. Foreground orbital roadside billboard is hand-painted, cute corporate smiling recycling-planet logo; its only legible lettering is '您的文明，我们善后'. One freighter has a small dangling garbage bag, comic understatement. In the distance a tiny sun like a vaporwave half-disc. Establish the unfair but silly scale of turning Earth into the galaxy's dumping ground. Strong readable composition, detailed but not noisy, no hero robot necessary in this establishing shot. No contract document UI, no additional text.
